0274_inference_backend_probe.schema.json.title: Inference Backend transaction-bound setup probe
0274_inference_backend_probe.schema.json.$comment: The encrypted subject preserves the original Workspace transaction snapshot. Only the fixed policy and open RPCs are granted to the dedicated probe client; credentials and the database-local key are never returned to Workspace.

tables.name: aap_inference_backend_probe_v1.probe_secret
tables.semantics: One database-local random 32-byte key. No client or Workspace role receives direct table privileges; there is no rotation or per-probe state.

functions.semantics: Secret-free readiness metadata. ready is true only when the singleton 32-byte key exists.

returns.description: The exact encrypted snapshot's original Backend JSON text, including endpoint credentials; never a current registry reread.

functions.semantics: Accepts only v1.<contiguous-base64> PGP-authenticated AES256 subjects bound to the requested registry, current database, and an originating full XID whose status is still in progress. The subject also works from its originating caller transaction. Committed, aborted, tampered, oversized, or foreign-database subjects fail with one generic invalid-subject error.

0276_inference_health_observation.schema.title: Inference transaction-bound health observation evidence
0276_inference_health_observation.schema.$comment: Provider transport receives only authenticated snapshot subjects and returns sealed raw observation text. The original caller verifies evidence before running its existing health, GPU, pool, flush and commit phases.

tables.name: aap_inference_health_observation_v1.observation_secret
tables.semantics: One database-local random 32-byte AES256/PGP key; no rotation or per-observation state. Neither dedicated client receives table privileges.

functions.semantics: Secret-free readiness metadata. ready is true only while the singleton 32-byte key exists.

arguments.name: p_backend_json
arguments.description: Exact JSON text for the caller-loaded seven-field Backend snapshot. JSON syntax and the fixed top-level field types are validated, while the original text is encrypted unchanged.

arguments.name: p_timeout_seconds
arguments.description: Any finite value, including zero or negative values, preserving existing transport behavior.

functions.semantics: Binds the exact JSON text, registry/request ids, optional GPU challenge, finite timeout, current database and assigned origin xid. Performs no registry query, row lock, flush or business write. Input is limited to 16 MiB.

returns.description: JSON text with exact fields backend_json, gpu_health_challenge and timeout_seconds. backend_json is returned as a JSON string containing its original bytes after UTF-8 decoding.

functions.semantics: Provider-only open. Requires canonical contiguous base64, authenticated header, exact ids/database, and an originating xid still in progress. Subject size is limited to 24 MiB.

arguments.name: p_observation_json
arguments.description: Raw observation/outcome body text; intentionally not parsed as JSON so NaN/Infinity and legacy decode failures retain their original phase.

functions.semantics: Provider-only seal. Binds the raw body to SHA256(subject), database, origin xid and request/registry ids; validates that the subject's originating transaction remains in progress. Body size is limited to 16 MiB.

returns.description: The original raw observation/outcome body, unchanged.

functions.semantics: Origin-only verify. Requires matching subject digest, ids, database, origin xid, current assigned transaction xid and in-progress status. Committed/aborted, cross-transaction, cross-database, tampered or mismatched evidence fails generically. Evidence size is limited to 24 MiB.

0277_inference_health_data.schema.json.$comment: Fixed typed reads and narrowly scoped health mutations on the original caller transaction. All reconciliation locks follow Registry to Pool to Member.

functions.semantics: Secret-free readiness for the fixed eleven-function data capability. No tables, per-request state, or transaction control.

arguments.name: p_for_update
arguments.description: False performs a plain full-row SELECT; true locks the Registry row FOR UPDATE.

functions.semantics: Returns the full Registry record in ORM model order, including unused JSONB fields so materialization errors retain their prior phase. Missing Registry returns zero rows. Null arguments, including the lock selector, raise 22023.

arguments.name: p_for_update
arguments.description: False performs a plain SELECT; true locks the matching membership FOR UPDATE.

functions.semantics: Reads only the exact backend/resource pair whose state is pending or active. Missing or retiring membership returns zero rows; there is no arbitrary state selector.
Returns clock_timestamp() on the caller's current transaction.

Attempts the existing transaction advisory lock for aap:gpu-membership-promotion and returns the native try-lock result.

arguments.name: p_health_meta_json
arguments.description: Null or JSON text for an object/JSON null; parsed only at this write phase.

arguments.name: p_is_interactive
arguments.description: Used only when p_has_interactive is true.

functions.semantics: Updates only Registry state, last_checked_at, health_meta, optional is_interactive, and updated_at=now(). Returns affected rows. Health metadata is limited to object or JSON null. Invalid JSON reaches this write phase rather than an earlier observation phase.
Unlocked scalar lookup of a registry's current Pool id; missing member returns SQL null.

Locks the selected Registry FOR KEY SHARE first, then loads and locks the requested Pool FOR UPDATE. A missing Registry or Pool returns zero rows. It does not require that the Registry still belongs to that Pool; the caller rechecks the locked Member.

No Python canonicalization or health/quiescence authority is duplicated.

0278_inference_registry_ingress.schema.j.$comment: Fixed caller-transaction Native functions for environment Registry sync and screenshot seed ingress. No HTTP, probe, capability or project-binding policy is accepted as a write boolean.

functions.semantics: Secret-free metadata for exactly eleven fixed functions.

0279_inference_routing.schema.json.$comment: PostgreSQL owns admission scopes, HTTP attempts, pool selection state, management holds, backend continuity, and minimal command receipts. Redis is not quiescence evidence.

actions.name: runtime_snapshot
actions.semantics: Read-only; omits absent registries, sorts returned rows by registry_id, and never expires scopes or proves physical quiescence.

private_tables.name: aap_inference_routing_v1.registry_state
private_tables.semantics: Registry insert creates unverified state; config/eligibility revisions are independent.

private_tables.name: aap_inference_routing_v1.scopes
private_tables.semantics: Only reserved scopes with no attempts may expire. Active and uncertain work persists.

private_tables.name: aap_inference_routing_v1.attempts
private_tables.semantics: One row per real HTTP attempt; no transport payload or credentials.

private_tables.name: aap_inference_routing_v1.weights
private_tables.semantics: Durable SWRR current weights, cleared when pool generation advances.

private_tables.name: aap_inference_routing_v1.controls
columns: recovered_kind unload|reload nullable (only for recovered epoch controls)
private_tables.semantics: Prepared and uncertain rows remain exclusive management holds. An unresolved unload or reload may be recovered under its same control ID as an epoch hold; recovered_kind preserves the original operation.

private_tables.name: aap_inference_routing_v1.control_attempts
private_tables.semantics: Unload/reload hold completion derives from these actual HTTP attempts.

private_tables.name: aap_inference_routing_v1.command_receipts
private_tables.semantics: Minimal result only; endpoint credentials, raw probe data and signing keys are rejected.

0280_inference_scope_retirement.schema.j.title: Inference Native scope retirement
0280_inference_scope_retirement.schema.j.$comment: Migration 0280 adds an immutable backend scope-retirement intent. The Native transaction closes one admission scope before a separate bounded HTTP exchange, then reconciles only that scope after a reply from the exact bound backend incarnation proves retired with zero tracked requests.

policy.ready: database-local routing authority secret is available

actions.name: prepare
actions.semantics: Validates the current realm, scope capability, committed transport and bound epoch/incarnation. It serializes against begin_attempt using the scope row lock, closes admission, and persists a replayable immutable intent before HTTP is sent. Same-ID replay returns that intent; another ID for the same scope conflicts.

actions.name: status
actions.semantics: Read-only; requires the original realm-bound scope capability and never returns endpoint credentials.

actions.name: finish
actions.semantics: Requires the exact pinned retirement identity and a still-current transport/epoch/incarnation. Draining remains unresolved. Only retired with active_requests=0 reconciles active or uncertain attempts in this scope; response rows and all other scopes remain unchanged.

private_tables.name: aap_inference_routing_v1.scope_retirements
private_tables.semantics: Unique scope identity makes retirement ID immutable for that scope. The full transport identity hash and config revision pin Registry state without storing another bearer copy; guarded prepare/finish calls derive endpoint credentials from the current Registry row only in private context. Credentials never enter command receipts or public retirement views.

aap_inference_routing_v1.scopes.admissio.semantics: High-water for every exact admission JWT exp. Existing 0279 scopes are conservatively fenced until migration time plus 300 seconds because their prior exact expiries were not stored; new scopes start at epoch and the signer records each actual exp atomically.

guards: Open retirements count as unresolved work for Registry and management admission.
Management control preparation and epoch/incarnation changes are fenced while a retirement is open.

Lock order is Registry SHARE, registry_state, scope, retirement; begin_attempt uses the same scope serialization plus compatible Registry SHARE. Contended Native locks return management_busy without HTTP in the transaction.
A timeout, lost reply, replacement incarnation, or zero count from a different incarnation never completes retirement or reconciles attempts.
Downgrade refuses open retirements and restores the 0279 admission signer before dropping the high-water column.

0356_inference_pool_reference.schema.jso.title: Inference Pool reference read capability
0356_inference_pool_reference.schema.jso.$comment: A fixed nonlocking Pool-by-primary-key read for historical Mask prediction lineage. It does not read Registry or membership state.

functions.semantics: Unlocked Pool primary-key lookup independent of Registry and membership. Missing Pool returns zero rows.

0369_inference_backend_endpoint.schema.j.title: Inference purpose-bound backend endpoint capability
0369_inference_backend_endpoint.schema.j.$comment: Capture seals the exact endpoint snapshot in the caller transaction; stateful capture validates the existing route/control capability and transport identity, discarding any route hash locator. Read openers require an in-progress origin transaction and preserve pending endpoint values; mutation openers require an unused attempt and still-live scope/control plus current endpoint. The owner issues its own fresh transport subject before begin. Credential-free readers never export auth_token.

tables.name: aap_inference_backend_endpoint_v1.endpoint_secret
tables.rows: Exactly one cryptographic secret is created with this payload; table access is revoked from PUBLIC and function-only clients.

functions.semantics: Exact native policy, fixed function inventory and endpoint-secret readiness.
Return only the stored auth method and exact bearer-length policy fact for controlled-model admission; never return auth_token.

Capture exact endpoint JSON in the caller-owned transaction. Read purposes require null authority; stateful purposes validate the live scope/control and exact transport identity with the existing routing capture_transport_subject, discarding its subject. Never expose the endpoint record or capability.
Open only health_observation subjects with no route authority; require origin transaction in progress and preserve exact pending endpoint snapshot without comparing committed registry state.
Open only setup subjects with no route authority; require origin transaction in progress and preserve exact pending endpoint snapshot without comparing committed registry state.
Open only catalog-fallback subjects with no route authority; require origin transaction in progress and preserve exact pending endpoint snapshot without comparing committed registry state.
Open only stats subjects with no route authority; require origin transaction in progress and preserve exact pending endpoint snapshot without comparing committed registry state.
Open only backend_read subjects with no route authority; require origin transaction in progress and preserve exact pending endpoint snapshot without comparing committed registry state.
Open lifecycle subjects only with the exact live unload/reload control, current endpoint, and unused request attempt before owner begin; preserve the API caller's pre-I/O commit boundary.
Open execution subjects only with the exact live route scope, current endpoint, and unused request attempt before owner begin.
Open GPU-control subjects only with the exact live control, current endpoint, and unused request attempt before owner begin.
Open only the exact authorized, unsettled GPU terminal intent and unchanged endpoint under the current membership and fence.
Caller-UOW read/lock for existing health reconciliation. It returns only a digest of the exact endpoint record, never auth_token.
Connected and non-disconnected health/stat selection in created order; no endpoint configuration, credential, or auth grouping key is returned.
Non-disconnected catalog selection in created order; no endpoint configuration or credential is returned.
Return only registered observation labels matching caller-provided exact URLs; never materialize credentials.

0369_inference_gpu.schema.json.title: Inference GPU PostgreSQL Native authority contract

request.arguments: UTF-8 JSON object passed as the second text argument; maximum 1 MiB
request.action: First text argument; one member of actions; action-specific exact key sets, types, and closed enums are enforced
request.uow: Runs inside and borrows the caller's transaction; never commits or opens a transaction

arguments.description: At most one selector may be non-null; both null lists all registry rows, a resource selector lists its members, and a backend selector reads one registry row.

caller_native.transaction: Borrows caller-owned workflow transaction; exposes only bounded administrative actions and public facts.

request.request_id: outer request UUID for owner correlation

reply.settled: false when the session is already unknown or expired

dispatch_http.session_semantics: Owner-process in-memory context only; expiry/shutdown settles as uncertain, never stopped; no durable result/stop ledger.

admin_http.transport: JSON request/response bodies; models reject undeclared fields

owner_protocol.name: GPUAuthorityData and GPUAuthorityDataProvider
owner_protocol.native_calls: Caller supplies one action and its finite argument object; provider dispatches only to the two declared authority functions.
owner_protocol.transaction: Caller supplies the UOW; Native functions borrow its transaction, never commit or open a transaction. Lock order is resource advisory lock, membership rows by backend UUID, fence rows by backend UUID, then plain registry reads. Registry rows are not locked to avoid inverse registry/resource lock order.
owner_protocol.security_boundary: Native projects only finite membership, fence, rollout, proof, residency and diagnostic facts. It never projects endpoint_subject, request_id, endpoint URL, auth method/token or private credentials; endpoint capture/opening and token signing remain separate live owner capabilities. Health and Redis effects run in the owner while its caller transaction remains open.

collector_native.security_boundary: The proof carries only endpoint_sha256 and a bounded residency DTO, never endpoint_subject, request_id, URL, auth material, or private credentials.
collector_native.transaction: Caller-owned UOW remains open while the owner verifies the Redis receipt and collection evidence. Lock order is resource advisory lock, membership row, fence row, then plain registry read. Prepare returns receipt_required or proof_valid; commit sets the exact transaction-local GC receipt only after receipt verification, deletes only the exact retiring membership, and deletes its fence only when the registry is absent.

positive_decimal.description: Canonical positive int64 decimal string; upper bound 9223372036854775807.

nonnegative_decimal.description: Canonical nonnegative int64 decimal string; upper bound 9223372036854775807.

Registry SHARE, Pool UPDATE, owned Member UPDATE in prescribed order.

Pool then Member transition to draining; no later Registry wait.
